Treatment-specific action taken information collected separately for Capecitabine and Cisplatin was consolidated into a single SDTM AEACN variable

Source data contained treatment-specific causality assessments for Capecitabine and Cisplatin in separate variables. AEREL was derived as RELATED when either treatment-specific causality variable indicated relatedness and NOT RELATED when either variable indicated no relationship.
Source adverse event coding data did not contain MedDRA High Level Term Code (AEHLTCD) or High Level Group Term Code (AEHLGTCD) information; therefore, these variables were left blank.

The AE source dataset contained an SAE indicator variable for all adverse event records. Detailed serious adverse event criteria information was available only in the separate SAE source dataset. SAE records were linked to AE records using AEREFID from the SAE dataset and AESEQ from the AE dataset. Seriousness criteria variables were populated only for AE records with matching SAE detail records.
Randomization ratio information required for ARMNRS and ARMNRSU was not available in the source data; therefore, these variables were left blank.
Country information was not available in the source data; therefore, COUNTRY was left blank.
Site identifier information was not available in the source data; therefore, SITEID was left blank.

Source disposition data contained non-specific values such as "OTHER" without additional descriptive information. Since no further detail was available in the de-identified source data, the collected terminology was retained in DSTERM and standardized to "OTHER EVENT" in DSDECOD.

Although later visit records were present in the source data, corresponding vital signs measurements were unavailable. Therefore, VSTEST, VSTESTCD, and result variables were populated only for Screening visit records.
Vital signs collection date/time information was not available in the source data; therefore, VSSTDTC was left blank.
Last observation before exposure flag information was not available in the source data; therefore, VSLOBXFL was left blank.
